name: Make a batch update atomic
description: A small in-memory transaction helper leaks earlier writes when a later operation fails. Repair it so successful batches commit once, rejected batches restore the original state, and the trace records rollback versus commit explicitly.
prompt: Work test-first in this fixture. FIRST run `npm test` and inspect the failures. Then repair `src/transaction.js` so `applyTransaction(state, operations)` is atomic: valid debit/credit operations commit to a new state and append `transaction.committed`; invalid, overdraft, or unknown operations return `ok: false`, preserve the original state exactly, and append `transaction.rolled_back` without a commit event. Keep the ordered `transaction.started` and operation-applied events. Run `npm test` again after the fix. Do not modify `src/transaction.test.js` or `package.json`.

benchmark.intent: Whether an agent can preserve atomic state semantics and an auditable commit/rollback trace when a multi-step update partially fails.
benchmark.deliverable: A tested transaction helper with no partial state leak and explicit rollback/commit events.
